scripts.text: It's 10,000 Zeny to go to Port Malaya. Interested?
Port Malaya is a small village you could reach by sailing southwest from Alberta.
scripts.translation: 马来港是个小村庄，从艾尔贝塔往西南方乘船就能抵达。

scripts.text: I couldn't visit the village because they had some issues there but now it seems all is clear!
scripts.translation: 之前村里出了些问题，我没能去成，不过现在好像已经没事了！

scripts.text: I don't know for sure but it was a village that's like a comfortable and cozy park.
scripts.translation: 我也说不准，不过那是个像舒适温馨的公园一样的村庄。

scripts.text: I was this close to not coming back to cozy Alberta again.
scripts.translation: 我差点就不回舒适的艾尔贝塔了。

scripts.text: I'm sure you'll feel the same once you reach Port Malaya.
scripts.translation: 等你到了马来港，一定也会有同样的感受。

scripts.text: You don't know how far it is from here. Of course it's not free. Please come back with 10,000 Zeny. Sorry!
scripts.translation: 你不知道这里离那里有多远吧。当然不是免费的。请带10,000zeny再来。抱歉！

scripts.text: Adventurers these days act like they are busy. Come back when you have the time and we could go visit Port Malaya together.
scripts.translation: 现在的冒险者总是一副很忙的样子。等你有空再来，我们可以一起去马来港。

scripts.text: I think the village is still busy. Done with your visit? There is always a ship heading for Alberta.
scripts.translation: 村里应该还很忙。你参观完了吗？随时都有船开往艾尔贝塔。

scripts.text: I think a nameless adventurer helped take a load off the villagers' minds. Yahoo! Would you like to go back to Alberta?
scripts.translation: 我想有位无名冒险者帮村民解决了心头大患。呀呼！要回艾尔贝塔吗？

scripts.text: Would you like to go back to Alberta with me?
scripts.translation: 要和我一起回艾尔贝塔吗？

scripts.text: Great! Let's leave now for Alberta!!
scripts.translation: 太好了！我们现在就出发回艾尔贝塔！！

scripts.text: That's okay. Come here if you ever want to go back to Alberta.
scripts.translation: 没关系，想回艾尔贝塔时再来找我。

scripts.text: What bad timing. The village is a bit unorganized at the moment so I'm actually closed. Sorry.
scripts.translation: 真不巧，村里现在有点混乱，所以旅馆暂时歇业。抱歉。

scripts.text: So you are the adventurer villagers are talking about? I reopened my inn thanks to you. Thank you.
scripts.translation: 你就是村民们谈论的那位冒险者吧？多亏了你，我的旅馆重新开张了。谢谢。

scripts.text: This is Port Malaya's best inn, 'Cabin in the City'.
scripts.translation: 这里是马来港最好的旅馆“城中小屋”。

scripts.text: Come for a rest? Lodging will be 5,000 Zeny.
scripts.translation: 要休息一下吗？住宿费是5,000zeny。

scripts.text: Successfully stored. See you next time.
Sorry. I think you are a bit short.
The unidentified creature gets a glimpse of you, blushes and then disappears.
scripts.translation: 不明生物瞥了你一眼，脸红了一下，然后消失了。

scripts.text: The unidentified creature gets a glimpse of you and disappears.
scripts.translation: 不明生物瞥了你一眼，然后消失了。

scripts.text: The unidentified creature looks at you and runs away.
scripts.translation: 不明生物看了你一眼，转身跑开了。

scripts.text: The unidentified creature gets a glimpse of you, blushes and then disappears.
scripts.translation: 不明生物瞥了你一眼，脸红了一下，然后消失了。

scripts.text: The unidentified creature gets a glimpse of you and disappears.
scripts.translation: 不明生物瞥了你一眼，然后消失了。

scripts.text: The unidentified creature looks at you and runs away.
scripts.translation: 不明生物看了你一眼，转身跑开了。

scripts.text: You're not from around here? Take care of yourself.
scripts.translation: 你不是本地人吧？要照顾好自己。

scripts.text: I'm worried because my daughter-in-law is pregnant. I hope nothing goes wrong.
scripts.translation: 我很担心怀孕的儿媳，希望一切顺利。

scripts.text: I heard there is an outsider that is helping the village.
scripts.translation: 听说有个外来者正在帮助村子。

scripts.text: Then my daughter-in-law will be safe.
scripts.translation: 这样我的儿媳就安全了。

scripts.text: Heard there is this {0} that follows Meoneonuncle around.
scripts.translation: 听说有个叫{0}的人总跟着梅奥尼奥叔叔。

scripts.text: I will cheer for their forbidden love.
scripts.translation: 我要为他们的禁忌之恋加油。

scripts.text: I'm worried about my pregnant daughter-in-law. Hope Meoneonuncle won't bother her.
scripts.translation: 我很担心怀孕的儿媳，希望梅奥尼奥叔叔别去打扰她。

scripts.text: Not from around here? Let me tell you why even a foreigner like you should be careful.
scripts.translation: 你不是本地人吧？让我告诉你，为什么连外地人也得小心。

scripts.text: Meoneonuncle was a woman who lived in Port Malaya long ago. She married a decent man and also had a baby.
scripts.translation: 梅奥尼奥叔叔是很久以前住在马来港的一名女子。她嫁给了一位好男人，还生了孩子。

scripts.text: But happiness never lasts forever, right? The baby was miscarried from an accident...
scripts.translation: 可是幸福不会永远持续，对吧？一次意外让她流产了...

scripts.text: She eventually passed away after grieving over her lost baby for days.
scripts.translation: 她为失去孩子悲伤了数日，最后也离开了人世。

scripts.text: Meoneonuncle then started to appear in spirit and take away babies from pregnant women in the village.
scripts.translation: 从那以后，梅奥尼奥叔叔便化作幽灵出现，把村里孕妇的孩子带走。

scripts.text: If you ever walk around Port Malaya at night...
scripts.translation: 如果你夜里在马来港闲逛...

scripts.text: And hear either tik-tik or wak-wak, be cautious because that is the sound of Meoneonuncle's wings flapping.
scripts.translation: 听到“嗒嗒”或“哇哇”的声音时要小心，那是梅奥尼奥叔叔拍动翅膀的声音。

scripts.text: Ugh... it's just like that time before...
When the moon was swallowed. Argh!
I think the village was saved by a nameless adventurer.
scripts.translation: 我想村子是被一位无名冒险者救下的。

scripts.text: Phew... I thought Bakonawa appeared again.
scripts.translation: 呼...我还以为巴可纳瓦又出现了。

scripts.text: {0} is said to have stopped Bakonawa from swallowing the moon. Isn't it awesome? I'm so relieved.
scripts.translation: 听说{0}阻止了巴可纳瓦吞掉月亮。太厉害了吧？我总算放心了。

scripts.text: Bakonawa is also known as the 'monster that swallows the moon' in Port Malaya.
scripts.translation: 在马来港，巴可纳瓦也被称为“吞月怪”。

scripts.text: But I know that Bakonawa could also 'swallow people', too.
scripts.translation: 不过我知道巴可纳瓦也会“吞人”。

scripts.text: Ha ha ha. There is a way to stop Bakonawa from swallowing a person.
scripts.translation: 哈哈哈。其实有办法阻止巴可纳瓦吞人。

scripts.text: Yes, there is a weakness to even the worst monster that swallowed 6 moons already.
scripts.translation: 没错，就连已经吞下六个月亮的凶恶魔物也有弱点。

scripts.text: He is sensitive to noise so when he's about to swallow the moon!!
scripts.translation: 它对声音很敏感，所以当它准备吞月亮时！！

scripts.text: That's your chance!! It doesn't matter what kind of noise!! Whether it's a caldron, symbol, drum, pot or fry pan, just keep on making noise.
scripts.translation: 那就是机会！！制造什么声音都行！！不管是敲锅、铜钹、鼓、罐子还是煎锅，尽管弄出声音。

scripts.text: Then Bakonawa will get surprised, spit out the moon and run away!
scripts.translation: 这样巴可纳瓦就会吓一跳，吐出月亮逃走！

scripts.text: Carry a drum around with you. You'll find it handy.
scripts.translation: 随身带一面鼓吧，会派上用场的。

scripts.text: The village is chaotic these days. Is it okay for me to be off like this?
scripts.translation: 村子最近很混乱。我这样擅离职守没问题吗？

scripts.text: The village is somewhat stable now but you should still be careful walking around at night.
scripts.translation: 村子现在稍微安定些了，但夜里在外面走还是要小心。

scripts.text: {0} is said to escape from Buwaya alive after being captured. This person must be powerful.
scripts.translation: 听说{0}被布瓦亚抓走后还能活着逃出来。这人一定很厉害。

scripts.text: Huh? You're not the captain? You scared me. Shoot! Ah, right! I received an official document for travelers.
scripts.translation: 咦？你不是船长？吓我一跳。哎呀！对了！我收到一份给旅客看的官方文件。

scripts.text: It says that travelers should be careful of monsters when walking in the village at night.
scripts.translation: 上面说，旅客夜间在村里行走时要小心魔物。

scripts.text: Buwaya don't come to the village often but there are cases when they snatch people in the boxes they carry at night.
scripts.translation: 布瓦亚不常进村，不过也发生过夜里把人抓进随身箱子的情况。

scripts.text: Huh?! And it says here that a monster named Wokwok especially visits the village often at night and should be avoided.
scripts.translation: 咦？！这里还说有种叫沃克沃克的魔物经常在夜间进村，应该避开。

scripts.text: Is there any way to prevent them from coming?
scripts.translation: 有什么办法能阻止它们来吗？

scripts.text: They say you can attack Buwaya's weak point inside the box they carry if you ever get caught in one.
scripts.translation: 据说如果被布瓦亚抓进箱子里，可以攻击箱子内部的弱点。

scripts.text: And you should run into the nearest building when you hear Wokwoks wings fluttering from afar.
scripts.translation: 听到远处沃克沃克拍翅膀的声音，就要赶快躲进最近的建筑里。

scripts.text: But if the fluttering sound is small or if you don't hear anything, let's just say you should prepare for attack and wish for luck.
scripts.translation: 但如果拍翅声很轻，或者根本听不到，那就做好迎战准备，祈求好运吧。

scripts.text: I'm scared but I have to visit the fairy in the forest.
scripts.translation: 我有点害怕，但还是想去森林里拜访仙子。

scripts.text: He he. Father said I can visit the fairy in the forest when the village calms down.
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿，爸爸说等村子安定下来，我就可以去森林里拜访仙子。

scripts.text: A little while ago {0} came and told me a fun story.
scripts.translation: 刚才{0}来给我讲了个有趣的故事。

scripts.text: 'I planted a pair of pear trees in the yard.'
He he. Isn't it fun? {0} seems like a fun person.
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿，很有趣吧？{0}好像是个有趣的人。

scripts.text: Father said I won't catch skin diseases once I'm friends with the fairy from the forest.
scripts.translation: 爸爸说，只要和森林里的仙子交朋友，我就不会得皮肤病。

scripts.text: Encan'to! Encan'to fairies live in big trees or rocks in the forest. There are boy fairies and girl fairies...
scripts.translation: 恩坎托！恩坎托仙子住在森林的大树或岩石里。有男仙子和女仙子...

scripts.text: But boy fairies are prettier. Why is that?
scripts.translation: 可是男仙子更漂亮。为什么呢？

scripts.text: My mom told me not to play outside because its dangerous. Why?
scripts.translation: 妈妈说外面很危险，不让我出去玩。为什么呀？

scripts.text: My mom told me I can play but only in Port Malaya.
scripts.translation: 妈妈说我可以玩，但只能在马来港里面。

scripts.text: He he. But I never thought of going outside of Port Malaya.
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿。不过我从没想过要离开马来港。

scripts.text: I heard someone took Jejelings hat in Baryo Mahiwaga.
scripts.translation: 我听说有人在巴里奥·马希瓦加拿走了杰杰灵的帽子。

scripts.text: Why would someone steal a monster's hat? {0} must be desperate.
scripts.translation: 为什么要偷魔物的帽子？{0}一定是走投无路了。

scripts.text: Oh wait! This was suppose to be a secret. Shsh! Please pretend you didn't hear me.
scripts.translation: 等等！这本来是个秘密。嘘！请当作没听见。

scripts.text: I think someone is stealing all the hats in the village.
scripts.translation: 我觉得有人正在偷村里所有的帽子。

scripts.text: The hat my mom washed yesterday disappeared. Our neighbor's hat also disappeared a few days ago.
scripts.translation: 妈妈昨天洗的帽子不见了。邻居家的帽子几天前也不见了。

scripts.text: Hmm... do you think Jejeling took it?
scripts.translation: 嗯...你觉得是杰杰灵拿走的吗？

scripts.text: I visited a friend in Baryo Mahiwaga and he said he saw Jejeling wearing the missing hat...
scripts.translation: 我去巴里奥·马希瓦加拜访朋友，他说看见杰杰灵戴着那顶失踪的帽子...

scripts.text: Hmm... is it time to be careful of the witches' curse?
scripts.translation: 嗯...该提防女巫的诅咒了吗？
外地人，小心蒙库库鲁姆的针。
外地人，欢迎来到马来港。

scripts.text: The village is chaotic these days. If you see someone with red eyes, try not to stare at their eyes.
scripts.translation: 村子最近很混乱。如果看到红眼睛的人，尽量别盯着他们的眼睛看。

scripts.text: Be careful walking around the village at night. {0} was taken down by Wokwok.
scripts.translation: 夜里在村中行走要小心。{0}被沃克沃克袭击了。

scripts.text: {0} is said to have successfully tamed a Tikbalang. This person must be courageous. Wonder if I'll get to see this tamed Tikbalang?
scripts.translation: 听说{0}成功驯服了提克巴朗。这人一定很勇敢。不知道我能不能看看驯服后的提克巴朗？

scripts.text: Have you ever seen Bongisungisu? I heard {0} is hunting down Bongisungisus.
scripts.translation: 你见过邦吉松吉苏吗？听说{0}正在追捕邦吉松吉苏。

scripts.text: If you plan to go out of the village, be careful of Tiucknuc. {0} is said to be tricked by Tiucknuc and had to go to the hospital.
scripts.translation: 如果你打算出村，要小心提克努克。据说{0}被提克努克骗了，还进了医院。

scripts.text: The village is chaotic these days. Looks like Mongkukurum is back in the village.
scripts.translation: 村子最近很混乱。看来蒙库库鲁姆又回来了。

scripts.text: A monster that is also called witch. Looks like a person and also wears clothes.
scripts.translation: 一种也被称为女巫的魔物。它看起来像人，还会穿衣服。

scripts.text: Mongkukurum makes a doll out of the people it sees and curses it with needles.
scripts.translation: 蒙库库鲁姆会把看到的人做成娃娃，再用针诅咒它。

scripts.text: Is there a way to recognize this monster?
scripts.translation: 有什么办法能认出这种魔物吗？

scripts.text: There is one way. All Mongkukurum have red eyes.
scripts.translation: 有个辨认方法：所有蒙库库鲁姆都有红眼睛。

scripts.text: You can recognize them by their eyes but! You must remember one thing.
scripts.translation: 你可以通过眼睛认出它们，不过！有件事一定要记住。

scripts.text: You will be captivated by Mongkukurum if you stare at their eyes too long.
scripts.translation: 如果盯着蒙库库鲁姆的眼睛看太久，就会被它迷惑。

scripts.text: Never ever stare into their eyes for too long.
scripts.translation: 千万别长时间盯着它们的眼睛。

scripts.text: Foreigners are not welcomed that much when our village is chaotic like these days.
scripts.translation: 村子像最近这样混乱时，我们不太欢迎外地人。

scripts.text: You are out of luck visiting the village at a time like this and not being welcomed.
scripts.translation: 你偏偏在这种时候来村里，真是不走运，也难怪没人欢迎你。

scripts.text: {0} is said to throw out Jellopy in this village.
scripts.translation: 听说{0}在村里乱扔杰勒比结晶。

scripts.text: Tsk, tsk... Must be a person that isn't worthy of a Jellopy.
scripts.translation: 啧啧...真是个不配拥有杰勒比结晶的人。

scripts.text: You must also look out to see if Bangungot lives in a tree you are about to cut down.
scripts.translation: 砍树之前，也要确认树上有没有邦贡诺特。

scripts.text: Because strange things happen if logs from trees that Bangungot lived in are used as building pillars.
scripts.translation: 如果把邦贡诺特住过的树做成房屋支柱，就会发生怪事。

scripts.text: Well, for a Bangungot, it means losing its home so they get vengeful.
scripts.translation: 对邦贡诺特来说，这等于失去了家，于是它们会怀恨在心。

scripts.text: When you try to sleep near the pillar, it will keep awake by playing pranks at first.
scripts.translation: 一开始，你睡在支柱旁时，它会用恶作剧让你睡不着。

scripts.text: But as time goes by and their vengeance grows, they sit on top of you until you suffocate.
scripts.translation: 但随着时间过去，怨恨越来越深，它们会坐到你身上，直到你窒息。

scripts.text: Ha ha ha. There are no Bangungots in normal pillars, so don't lose sleep over it.
scripts.translation: 哈哈哈，普通支柱里没有邦贡诺特，所以不用为此睡不着。

scripts.text: I don't have anything to share with you.
scripts.translation: 我没什么可以告诉你的。

scripts.text: Im worried about the children. I hope they aren't terrified from whats going on in the village.
scripts.translation: 我很担心孩子们，希望村里的事没有把他们吓坏。

scripts.text: I like fun stories. Not so long ago, {0} came and told me a funny story.
scripts.translation: 我喜欢有趣的故事。前不久，{0}来给我讲了个笑话。

scripts.text: 'You eat chili on a chilly day.'
'Why are you putting flour on that flower?'
scripts.translation: “你为什么把面粉撒在那朵花上？”

scripts.text: At the Tool Store, 'Ill buy the needle and thread! You buy the hay to lose the needle in.'
scripts.translation: 在道具店里，“我来买针和线！你去买干草，好让针掉进去！”

scripts.text: {0} said that and was kicked out of the Tool Store.
scripts.translation: {0}说完这句话，就被赶出了道具店。

scripts.text: A Kafra Employee I'm friends with told me a story about a customer.
scripts.translation: 我认识的一位卡普拉职员给我讲了个顾客的故事。

scripts.text: 'Kafra, the wise never marry and when they marry, they become otherwise.'
scripts.translation: “卡普拉，聪明人从不结婚；一旦结婚，就会变得不一样。”

scripts.text: He he... I do like funny stories but a bit difficult for my taste.
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿...我喜欢笑话，不过这个有点难懂。

scripts.text: I like fun stories. Oh by the way! {0}, love is photogenic. Don't you agree?
scripts.translation: 我喜欢有趣的故事。对了，{0}，爱情很上镜，你说呢？
不过需要在黑暗中冲洗才能显影。

scripts.text: If you hear a baby crying from the forest outside of the village, never go near it.
scripts.translation: 如果听见村外森林里有婴儿哭声，千万别靠近。

scripts.text: There is a monster named Tiucknuc that roams around outside of the village and cries after transforming himself into a baby.
scripts.translation: 有一种叫提克努克的魔物在村外游荡，它会变成婴儿哭泣。

scripts.text: But when kind travelers pick up the baby, it turns back into its original form and attacks.
scripts.translation: 善良的旅人把婴儿抱起来时，它就会变回原形发动攻击。
听起来是只狡猾的魔物

scripts.text: Yes, this monster is bad to trick the kindness of travelers but...
scripts.translation: 没错，这种魔物利用旅人的善意实在可恶，不过...

scripts.text: There is rumor that the monster came from the soul of a baby that never been born. So sad.
scripts.translation: 传闻这种魔物是未能出生的婴儿灵魂所化。真令人难过。

scripts.text: I'm afraid the Jeepney is full.
scripts.translation: 这辆吉普尼恐怕已经满员了。

scripts.text: I'm sorry but how about some other Jeepney?
scripts.translation: 抱歉，要不搭乘其他吉普尼？

scripts.text: Oh! Other Jeepneys are in operation, of course.
scripts.translation: 哦！当然还有其他吉普尼在运行。

scripts.text: In Port Malaya there are 12, 30 and 60 passenger Jeepneys with 3 each operating.
scripts.translation: 马来港有12人、30人和60人座的吉普尼，每种各有3辆在运行。

scripts.text: Would you like to know the location of other cars?
scripts.translation: 你想知道其他车辆的位置吗？

scripts.text: I'd like to know where the 12 passenger car is.
scripts.translation: 我想知道12人座车的位置

scripts.text: I'd like to know where the 30 passenger car is.
scripts.translation: 我想知道30人座车的位置

scripts.text: I'd like to know where the 60 passenger car is.
scripts.translation: 我想知道60人座车的位置

scripts.text: {0} passenger Jeepney's location has been marked on your map.
scripts.translation: {0}人座吉普尼的位置已标记在你的地图上。
